# Data

## The rule

**No real government identity document enters this repository, this dataset, or this demo.** Not scraped, not a teammate's, not "just for testing". Everything is generated by `data/generator/`.

The one exception is team face images for threshold calibration — real biometrics, held under written consent, stored outside the repo, deleted after the event.

## Why this matters more than convenience

Real Aadhaar, PAN, and passport images are protected under the Aadhaar Act 2016 and the DPDP Act 2023. An MHA panel is precisely the audience that will ask where your training data came from. Being able to answer *"every document in our system is synthetic, generated from published specimens with checksum-valid identity numbers"* is worth more than any dataset would have been.

---

## Tier 1 — Core document datasets

| Dataset | Gives you | Size | Where |
|---|---|---|---|
| **MIDV-2020** | The backbone. 1,000 mock documents, each with unique field values and artificially generated faces. Ground truth for text field values, document quadrangle, and face position in every frame. | 72,409 images | `ftp://smartengines.com/midv-2020` · `l3i-share.univ-lr.fr/MIDV2020` |
| MIDV-500 | 50 document types — more type diversity, weaker annotation. Doc-type robustness. | 500 clips | `ftp://smartengines.com/midv-500` |
| MIDV-2019 | MIDV-500 recaptured in low light and heavy projective distortion. Hardens quality gate and deskew. | — | `ftp://smartengines.com/midv-2019` |
| DocXPand-25k | Independent synthetic generator + field crops. **CC BY-NC-SA 4.0** — non-commercial, must be flagged. | 25k | `github.com/quicksign/docxpand` |

Download MIDV-2020 first. Everything else builds against it.

**Gap:** MIDV covers European documents. No Indian types. That gap is filled by Roboflow annotation schemas plus our own generation.

**Good news:** the Indian passport is standard ICAO TD3, so all MRZ work on MIDV's European passports transfers directly. Only the VIZ layout differs — a field-detection retrain, not new science.

---

## Tier 2 — Forgery and tampering

| Dataset | Gives you | Where |
|---|---|---|
| **SIDTD** | Closest on-target set. Extends MIDV-2020 with Crop&Replace and inpainting forgeries across ten nationalities. Ships a generator and baselines. | `github.com/Oriolrt/SIDTD_Dataset` |
| **MIDV-Holo** | Physical-forgery track. 700 clips with/without holograms, 400 presentation attacks including physical photo replacement. Ships hologram location masks. CC BY-SA 2.5. | `github.com/SmartEngines/midv-holo` |
| IDNet | Deliberately harder — its fraud samples are closer to the originals than SIDTD's. **Use as the hard test set, not training.** | `arxiv.org/abs/2408.01690` |
| DocTamper | Large-scale document text tampering with pixel masks. Mostly Chinese, but splice artifacts transfer. | `github.com/qcf-568/DocTamper` |

**Evaluation protocol:** train on SIDTD, **test on IDNet or MIDV-Holo**. A lower number on a harder, differently-generated set is more credible than a high number on your own distribution.

---

## Tier 3 — Generic forensics pretraining

Document forgery sets are too small to train from scratch.

| Dataset | Purpose | Where |
|---|---|---|
| CASIA v1/v2 | Splicing and copy-move baseline | Mirrored on GitHub/Kaggle |
| CoMoFoD | Copy-move with post-processing variants | `vcl.fer.hr/comofod` |
| DEFACTO | ~150k manipulations from MS-COCO — best for pretraining | Kaggle / IEEE DataPort |
| IMD2020 | Real-world manipulations found in the wild | `staff.utia.cas.cz/novozada/db` |

---

## Tier 4 — Face

| Dataset | Purpose | Where |
|---|---|---|
| LFW | 1:1 verification protocol. Sanity-check the threshold code. | `vis-www.cs.umass.edu/lfw` |
| **AgeDB-30** | Age-variant verification. **Most relevant** — a 10-year-old passport photo is your hardest genuine case. | InsightFace eval packs |
| CFP-FP | Frontal-to-profile | InsightFace eval packs |
| FairFace | Balanced across race, gender, age — bias audit | `github.com/joojs/fairface` |
| RFW | Standard demographic-bias benchmark | `whdeng.cn/RFW` |

**Do not download MS1M or VGGFace2.** You are not training a face model; ArcFace weights are pretrained. Downloading a training corpus you will not use is a classic time sink.

**No public dataset of doc-photo ↔ live-selfie pairs exists.** It is inherently PII. You must build it. See §Generation.

## Tier 5 — Liveness

| Dataset | Notes | Where |
|---|---|---|
| **CelebA-Spoof** | 625k images, 10k subjects, openly downloadable. The practical choice. | `github.com/ZhangYuanhan-AI/CelebA-Spoof` |
| LCC-FASD | Small, fast to iterate | Kaggle |
| CASIA-FASD, Replay-Attack, OULU-NPU, SiW | All require a signed university EULA. **Turnaround exceeds the hackathon. Skip.** | — |

## Roboflow Universe

**Build-time only.** Annotate, version, train, export ONNX. Never hosted inference at runtime.

| Aadhaar — best annotation | `sujeet-kumar-5vze5/aadhaar-details-detection` | 224, 15 named classes incl. security elements |

### Verified problems — do not use as claimed

| Project | Issue |
|---|---|
| `centurion.../aadhaar-card-details-extraction-n4hyw` | 2,645 images (not 6.3k), classes are unnamed integers `0`–`4` |
| `cutm-iwh4a/aadhaar-card-details` | **Identical dataset**, re-uploaded. Do not count twice. |
| `vexil-infotech/voterid-card-details-extraction` | **31 images.** Schema is good, model is worthless. |
| `passport-stamp/passport-stamp` | **47 images.** Correct schema, starting weights only. |
| `detect-for-id/passport-id` | Not a passport detector — it detects glasses, masks, headwear. Useful for ICAO photo compliance, nothing else. |
| `document-forgery-detection/...` | 402 images, class name is an export artifact. Popular ≠ good. |
| `docdetection-qgqkm/pan-document-classification` | `real_pan`/`fake_pan` with no auditable provenance. Avoid. |

**Verification procedure, 30 seconds per project:** check (1) image count — under ~150 is schema-only, (2) class names — integers or export boilerplate means unusable, (3) thumbnail — does it show a real person's card?

### Provenance warning

Most Indian ID datasets on Universe were built by scraping real cards. **Audit before use.** If you see real names and numbers: use the annotation *schema* only and re-annotate your own synthetic data, or mask everything before training. Never ship sample images from these sets in a presentation deck.

## Official specimen sources — the template base

Published by issuing authorities. Legally clean.

| Document | Source |
|---|---|
| Indian passport | **PRADO** — `consilium.europa.eu/prado`. Specimens with security features annotated. |
| Aadhaar letter / PVC | UIDAI sample card images in published guidelines. Note the hologram, ghost image, guilloche. |
| PAN | Income Tax Department official card format |
| Voter ID (EPIC) | Election Commission of India specimen |
| Driving licence | Parivahan / MoRTH — the smart-card format is specified under the Central Motor Vehicles Rules |
| MRZ layout | **ICAO Doc 9303**, free PDF, all 13 parts — `icao.int` |

---

## Reference data

| What | Where |
|---|---|
| ICAO Doc 9303 | `icao.int` |
| ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 | `pycountry` package |
| **OFAC SDN list** — real, free CSV/XML, includes names, DOBs, passport numbers | `ofac.treasury.gov/sanctions-list-service` |
| **UN Consolidated List** — free XML | `scsanctions.un.org` |

Load a real sanctions list rather than inventing one. It gives your watchlist realistic name-matching problems — transliteration variants, aliases, partial DOBs — which is the genuinely hard part and the part that impresses a panel.

---

## Generation — what you build

| Deliverable | How | Target |
|---|---|---|
| **Templates** | Vectorise official specimens into layers: guilloche background, static text, field slots, photo slot, QR slot | 6 types, ~1.5 days each |
| **Synthetic identities** | Faker `en_IN`. **Verhoeff-valid** Aadhaar, structurally valid PAN (holder-type character, fifth character matching the surname), TD3 MRZ with correct check digits, EPIC and DL formats | 2,000 |
| **Synthetic faces** | Reuse MIDV-2020's artificially generated faces — zero PII exposure | 2,000 |
| **Capture realism** | **Print the rendered templates, then scan and photograph** under varied lighting and angle | 3 captures each |
| **Doc ↔ live face pairs** | Print a face onto a mock template, scan it, capture live webcam frames on **the demo webcam**. Include deliberate impostor pairs. | 30–50 people, ~500 pairs |
| **Forgeries with masks** | Photo swap, DOB splice, VIZ↔MRZ desync, QR replacement, hologram removal, copy-move. Ground-truth mask on every one. | 2,000–3,000 |
| **Stamps** | No public dataset exists. Render synthetic stamps onto passport pages, then forge by duplicating and date-editing. | 1,000 |
| **Multi-document sessions** | Matched Aadhaar+PAN sets, plus deliberately inconsistent ones. Demos Layer D. | 300 |
| **Watchlist seed** | OFAC + UN + synthetic entries matching demo documents so hits actually fire | — |

**Do not skip print-and-rescan.** A model trained purely on clean digital renders falls apart on a real scanner. Two afternoons with a printer and a phone camera is the difference between a system that works on your laptop and one that works at the demo table.

**The doc↔live pairs are on the critical path.** Long lead time — you have to schedule people. Named owner, week 1.
